final: WITH matched AS (SELECT o.orderbase, f.feerate FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault COLLATE BINARY = f.orderslink COLLATE BINARY), channel_averages AS (SELECT orderbase, AVG(feerate) AS avg_rate FROM matched GROUP BY orderbase), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(feerate) AS avg_rate FROM matched) SELECT AVG(c.avg_rate) AS average_fee_rate, AVG(c.avg_rate - a.avg_rate) AS average_difference FROM channel_averages AS c JOIN overall_average AS a ON a.avg_rate IS NOT NULL WHERE c.avg_rate > a.avg_rate
